question: Which of the following is NOT a part of the female reproductive system?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Urethra**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The **Urethra** is part of the urinary system and not the female reproductive system.
 
• The female reproductive system includes structures such as the **Uterus, Ovaries, and Fallopian tubes**.
 
• The **Uterus** is where a fertilized egg implants and develops into a fetus.
 
• The **Ovaries** produce eggs and hormones like estrogen and progesterone.
 
• The **Fallopian tubes** transport the eggs from the ovaries to the uterus.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• The **Urethra** serves the role of expelling urine from the body.
 
• In females, the urethra is shorter and opens just above the vaginal opening.
 
• Understanding the distinction between the reproductive and urinary systems is crucial for comprehending human anatomy.
